name: intelli-factory
description: AI-optimized supply chain matching platform - Project root

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend/app/api && poetry run uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.seed:workflow: cd backend/app/api && poetry run python seed_workflow_scenarios.py
scripts.seed:workflow:random: cd backend/app/api && SCENARIO_RANDOM_BUNDLES=20 poetry run python seed_workflow_scenarios.py
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:py
scripts.format: npm run format:ts && npm run format:py
